title: Every published arm, beside the difference its own sample could resolve

gates.detail: 103 rows: every printed delta is its own discordant counts
103 rows: decided ⟺ the price is at or below the sample

statement: 103 arm rows over 21 artefacts, 18 decided at 80% power and 27 at a 95% interval, 103 reconciled; the largest claim was oracle − full at +32.5714pp on a design resolving 8.6224pp and the sharpest design resolved 0.8242pp; `full − none` has been measured 21 times, 1 could decide and 6 cleared a 95% interval, 3 of them positive; 36 rows sit under 1pp and were never decided.
